notes.title: Timberman: The Big Adventure is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Timberman: The Big Adventure is now available on Steam!


[previewyoutube=QvyZjxwnEqU;full][/previewyoutube]

Merge into the universe of Timberman! Enjoy the retro-vibe in a 2D platformer style with a 16-bit pixel art classy aesthetic.

Follow a lumberjack's story and join him on his way to help his bear friend reunite with family. Challenge the Evil Corp to rescue your friends and save the entire forest from the hands of industrialization.

Game features:
- Single-player and 2 player co-op mode.
- Engaging combo fighting system.
- Unique platform game mechanics.
- Shot projectiles using axe or boomerang.
- Mini-puzzles: chop and gather wood to construct bridges.

Remember: To be a real hero, you won't need much - being a big-hearted lumberjack equipped with an axe is more than enough.

notes.title: Timberman: The Big Adventure is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Follow a lumberjack's story and join him on his way to help his bear friend reunite with family. Challenge the Evil Corp to rescue your friends and save the entire forest from the hands of industrialization.

Enjoy the retro-vibe in a 2D platformer style with a 16-bit pixel art classy aesthetic. Fly on your axe to progress, use it to chop wood, build bridges, and solve mini puzzles. Fight your way through three colorfully and yet deadly worlds beat dozens of levels and face three unique bosses in epic battles.

Play the single-player story mode or take your friend on an adventure with you in a 2 player co-op mode!

Features:
•Single-player and 2-player co-op mode.
•Engaging combo fighting system.
•Unique platform game mechanics.
•Shot projectiles using axe or boomerang.
•Mini-puzzles: chop and gather wood to construct bridges

notes.title: Patch Note #2 | 22.10.2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33710387/04e4b7f29b975bc8bdb55499d5eacaf6c6aae84e.jpg[/img]

Hi Timbermen!
New week brings another update! This time we added the requested feature to invite friends to your match! Now you can join the tree-chopping competition with your Steam buddies ːsteamhappyː There are also few minor fixes, read the patch note below:

[h1]PATCH NOTE[/h1]
[list][*]Now you can make private matches in an online multiplayer and invite players from your Steam friend list
[*]Fixed leaderboard scrolling with keyboard and gamepads
[*]Fixed issue with Enter key not working in Classic and Race game modes[/list]

See you soon!
FE BluNectarine

notes.title: Patch Note #1 | 15.10.2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33710387/04e4b7f29b975bc8bdb55499d5eacaf6c6aae84e.jpg[/img]

Hi Timbermen!
We've listened to all your feedback and suggestions and we went straight back to work! First, we focused on the most important and highly requested fixes - but worry not, more improvements are on the way. Feel free to visit us on Steam forums and share with us your reports and ideas.

[h1]PATCH NOTE[/h1][list]
[*]Steam Overlay now pauses and blocks input in-game
[*]In all game modes (except for LOCAL multiplayer) you can now use every keybinding schemes
[*]In single player modes you can now use mouse buttons to move your character
[*]Input delay/missing fixed

See you soon!
FE BluNectarine
